title: Wallbox Off-Peak Utilization Below Target
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wallbox:session
stats sum(eval(if(offpeak=1,energy_kwh,0)))/sum(energy_kwh) as offpeak_share
where offpeak_share<0.7
description: Measures share of Wallbox energy delivered during off-peak tariff windows.
value: Surfacing wallbox off-peak utilization below target helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant connected cars & evs export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you when wallbox off-peak utilization below target matters for your routine.
